result.topic_en: Notes on a triangular system of linear congruences modulo powers of a prime p (with exponents a > b > c ...) and on expressing X as a quadratic or factored expression in ξ plus multiples of powers of p.
result.transcription:
Fiat
$\alpha X + \alpha' X' = p^{a} A$
$\beta X + \beta' X' + \beta'' X'' = p^{b} B$
$\gamma X + \gamma' X' + \gamma'' X'' + \gamma''' X''' = p^{c} C$
&c.

$a > b > c >$ &c.

$X = \xi^2 + pU$

$\xi$ [-...-] $\nu p$
$\nu^2 p^2$
$\xi^2 + p\lambda\xi + ppU$
[-$\nu\nu p$-] $+ \lambda\nu + U$
$X = (\xi + \mu p)(\xi + \nu p) +$ [-$pU + \mu p \nu p^2 \xi +$-]
[-$+ pU + pp\nu$-]
$+ pp\lambda\xi + p^3 U$

$\xi$ et $\xi'$ sec: p congr: sec. pp inc.

$X = \xi\xi' + pp\lambda\xi + p^3 \upsilon$ \quad $\lambda'\left(\frac{\xi - \xi'}{p}\right) + \lambda\frac{\xi - \xi'}{p} + \upsilon$
$\xi + \lambda pp$
$\lambda\left(\frac{\xi' - \xi}{p}\right) + \upsilon$ \quad $\xi + \frac{\upsilon}{\left[\frac{\xi' - \xi}{p}\right]}$
$\xi'$ [-...-] $\frac{\upsilon}{\frac{\xi' - \xi}{p}}$ [-...-] $\lambda$
$X = \xi\xi' + p^3\lambda\xi + \upsilon p^4$

methods.what: Triangular system of linear relations with right-hand sides divisible by decreasing powers of a prime p
Writing X as a square plus a multiple of p
Factoring X modulo powers of p as a product of two linear factors
Representation of X as a product of two values ξ, ξ' congruent mod p but not mod p², with correction terms
Adjusting ξ by a quotient involving (ξ'−ξ)/p to absorb the correction term
Refined representation with higher powers of p

items.english: Let it be that αX + α'X' = p^a A (and so on for the further equations).
